capabilities: play live radio streams from the radio-browser.info directory
embed a radio player card in notes via a radio code block
search, filter by category, and favorite stations in a sidebar panel
control playback and switch stations from a status bar mini player
fall back across up to three stream sources when one fails
extras: Bilingual English/Chinese README with detailed limitations: HTTP streams are filtered by default because Obsidian blocks mixed content, some CDN sources reject the app:// origin, and mobile is unverified. No telemetry, accounts, or payment. Includes extensive automated verification records and a DESIGN.md for the visual rules.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to listen to live radio streams or control playback without leaving the note you are writing in.

relations.evidence: Station directory: radio-browser.info, a public, key-free API.

summary: Live internet radio player that streams stations from the radio-browser.info directory through a note player card, a sidebar panel, and a status bar mini player.
